bible_quanes.question: Where was Nehemiah when he heard news of Jerusalem?
What report did Nehemiah receive about Jerusalem?
bible_quanes.answer: The wall was broken down and the gates burned
bible_quanes.explanation: The survivors were in great distress.

bible_quanes.question: How did Nehemiah respond to the news?
bible_quanes.answer: He wept, mourned, fasted and prayed

bible_quanes.question: What was Nehemiah's job?
Who brought Nehemiah the news?
How did Nehemiah address God in prayer?
bible_quanes.answer: The great and terrible God, that keepeth covenant and mercy

bible_quanes.question: Did Nehemiah include himself in the confession?
bible_quanes.answer: Yes; both he and his father's house had sinned
bible_quanes.explanation: He did not blame others only.

bible_quanes.question: Which promise to Moses did Nehemiah recall?
bible_quanes.answer: If ye turn unto me, and keep my commandments, yet will I gather them

bible_quanes.question: In which month did Nehemiah hear the news?
Who was Nehemiah's father?
Why was Nehemiah sad before the king?
bible_quanes.answer: The city of his fathers' sepulchres lay waste

bible_quanes.question: What did Nehemiah do before answering the king?
bible_quanes.answer: Prayed to the God of heaven

bible_quanes.question: Why did the king grant Nehemiah's requests?
bible_quanes.answer: The good hand of God was upon him

bible_quanes.question: What did Nehemiah tell those who mocked?
bible_quanes.answer: "The God of heaven, he will prosper us"

bible_quanes.question: In which month did Nehemiah speak to the king?
bible_quanes.explanation: In the twentieth year of Artaxerxes.

bible_quanes.question: Who were deeply disturbed that someone had come to help Israel?
When did Nehemiah inspect the walls?
bible_quanes.explanation: He told no one at first.

bible_quanes.question: Who was the third opponent who mocked them?
Who was keeper of the king's forest?
By which gate did Nehemiah go out at night?
Who built the Sheep Gate?
bible_quanes.answer: Eliashib the high priest with the priests

bible_quanes.question: Who did not put their shoulders to the work?
Who worked alongside Shallum on the wall?
Who built the Fish Gate?
Who repaired the Old Gate?
Which goldsmith worked on the wall?
Who repaired the Valley Gate?
bible_quanes.answer: Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah
bible_quanes.explanation: And a thousand cubits of the wall.

bible_quanes.question: Who repaired the Fountain Gate?
bible_quanes.explanation: And the wall of the Pool of Shelah.

bible_quanes.question: Who repaired the wall above the Horse Gate?
bible_quanes.answer: The priests, every one over against his house

bible_quanes.question: Who was keeper of the East Gate?
How did Tobiah mock the wall?
bible_quanes.answer: If a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall

bible_quanes.question: Why did the wall progress so well?
bible_quanes.answer: The people had a mind to work

bible_quanes.question: What did they do when enemies plotted against them?
bible_quanes.answer: Made prayer unto God and set a watch day and night

bible_quanes.question: How did the builders work?
bible_quanes.answer: With one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other hand held a weapon

bible_quanes.question: What did Sanballat ask mockingly?
bible_quanes.answer: Will they revive the stones from the heaps of rubbish?

bible_quanes.question: What did Nehemiah tell the people?
bible_quanes.answer: Remember the LORD, which is great and terrible, and fight for your families and houses

bible_quanes.question: Who stood beside Nehemiah?
Did they take off their clothes at night?
How far had the wall been built when the people worked so well?
bible_quanes.answer: All the wall was joined together unto the half thereof

bible_quanes.question: What were the people to do when they heard the trumpet?
bible_quanes.answer: Resort ye thither unto us: our God shall fight for us

bible_quanes.question: Against whom did the people cry out?
What did Nehemiah urge the nobles to stop?
bible_quanes.explanation: To stop the burden on the poor.

bible_quanes.question: What did Nehemiah not eat as governor?
What did Nehemiah pray?
bible_quanes.answer: "Think upon me, my God, for good"

bible_quanes.question: Why had people mortgaged their lands?
What were some forced to do because of debt?
bible_quanes.answer: Bring their sons and daughters into bondage

bible_quanes.question: What did Nehemiah tell the nobles to restore?
bible_quanes.answer: Their lands, vineyards, oliveyards and houses, and the hundredth part of the money

bible_quanes.question: How had former governors behaved?
bible_quanes.answer: They were chargeable unto the people
bible_quanes.explanation: Nehemiah feared God and did not.

bible_quanes.question: For which years was Nehemiah governor?
bible_quanes.answer: From the twentieth unto the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes

bible_quanes.question: How many Jews and rulers ate at Nehemiah's table?
Who invited Nehemiah to meet in the plain of Ono?
What was Nehemiah's answer?
bible_quanes.answer: "I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down"

bible_quanes.question: How long did it take to finish the wall?
bible_quanes.explanation: Completed on the twenty-fifth of Elul.

bible_quanes.question: How did the enemies react when the wall was finished?
bible_quanes.answer: They were much cast down: for they perceived that this work was wrought of our God

bible_quanes.question: How many times did they send the same message?
How was the fifth message sent?
Who tried to persuade Nehemiah to hide in the temple?
Which prophetess tried to make Nehemiah afraid?
How did Nehemiah answer the suggestion to hide?
bible_quanes.answer: "Should such a man as I flee?"
bible_quanes.explanation: He would not go into the temple to save his life.

bible_quanes.question: To whom were many in Judah bound by oath?
bible_quanes.explanation: He was a son-in-law of Shechaniah.

bible_quanes.question: To whom did Nehemiah give charge of Jerusalem?
When were the gates of Jerusalem to be opened?
bible_quanes.answer: Not until the sun was hot

bible_quanes.question: What did Nehemiah find?
bible_quanes.answer: A register of the genealogy of them which came up at the first

bible_quanes.question: How large was the whole assembly in Nehemiah's register?
bible_quanes.answer: Forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore
bible_quanes.explanation: The same total as in Ezra.

bible_quanes.question: How is Hananiah described?
bible_quanes.answer: A faithful man, and feared God above many

bible_quanes.question: What was Jerusalem's condition after the wall was built?
bible_quanes.answer: Large and great, but the people were few

bible_quanes.question: What did the governor give to the treasury?
When were the people settled in their cities?
How many men and women singers returned?
Who were told they should not eat of the most holy things?
bible_quanes.answer: They that were put from the priesthood, till there stood up a priest with Urim and Thummim
bible_quanes.explanation: Until a priest could consult the Urim and Thummim.

bible_quanes.question: Who read the Book of the Law to the people?
What did the people do when Ezra opened the book?
Complete: "The joy of the LORD is your ..."
What did the people make for the feast?
How long did Ezra read?
What did Ezra stand on?
bible_quanes.answer: A pulpit of wood made for the purpose

bible_quanes.question: How did the Levites help the people understand?
bible_quanes.answer: They read distinctly and gave the sense

bible_quanes.question: Why did the people weep?
bible_quanes.answer: They heard the words of the Law

bible_quanes.question: Since when had Israel not lived in booths like this?
bible_quanes.answer: The days of Jeshua the son of Nun

bible_quanes.question: Which branches were they to gather for booths?
bible_quanes.answer: Olive branches, pine branches, myrtle branches, and palm branches

bible_quanes.question: How did the people assemble on the twenty-fourth day?
bible_quanes.answer: With fasting, with sackclothes and earth upon them

bible_quanes.question: Who separated themselves from foreigners?
How does the Levites' prayer begin praising God?
What did the people make at the end of their prayer?
bible_quanes.answer: A sure covenant, and write it; and princes, Levites, and priests seal unto it

bible_quanes.question: How long did they read the Law?
Whom does the prayer say God chose?
bible_quanes.answer: Abram, and gavest him the name of Abraham

bible_quanes.question: How does the prayer describe God?
bible_quanes.answer: Ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger

bible_quanes.question: What happened in the forty years in the wilderness?
bible_quanes.answer: Their clothes waxed not old and their feet swelled not

bible_quanes.question: How is God described in Nehemiah 9:32?
bible_quanes.answer: The great, the mighty, and the terrible God, who keepest covenant and mercy

bible_quanes.question: What did the people say they were in their own land?
Who sealed the covenant first?
What did the people swear to do?
bible_quanes.explanation: Under a curse and an oath.

bible_quanes.question: What would they not buy on the Sabbath?
bible_quanes.explanation: From the peoples of the land.

bible_quanes.question: What was their final vow in Nehemiah 10?
bible_quanes.answer: "We will not forsake the house of our God"

bible_quanes.question: What did they vow about marriage?
bible_quanes.answer: Not to give their daughters unto the people of the land
bible_quanes.explanation: Nor take their daughters for their sons.

bible_quanes.question: What yearly charge did they agree to give?
bible_quanes.explanation: For the service of the house of God.

bible_quanes.question: How did they decide who would bring the wood offering?
What did they vow to bring each year?
bible_quanes.answer: The firstfruits of the ground and of all fruit trees
bible_quanes.explanation: To the house of the LORD.

bible_quanes.question: What did they agree to forgo in the seventh year?
bible_quanes.answer: The seventh year and the exaction of every debt

bible_quanes.question: To whom were the tithes of the ground to be brought?
bible_quanes.explanation: Who would tithe in their turn.

bible_quanes.question: Who lived in Jerusalem?
How were the rest of the people chosen to live in Jerusalem?
bible_quanes.answer: The rest of the people cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem

bible_quanes.question: How did the people treat those who volunteered to live in Jerusalem?
bible_quanes.answer: The people blessed all the men

bible_quanes.question: Who led the thanksgiving in prayer?
How many sons of Perez lived in Jerusalem?
Who was their overseer?
bible_quanes.explanation: Judah was second over the city.

bible_quanes.question: How many gatekeepers lived in Jerusalem?
How many Levites were in the holy city?
Who was overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem?
bible_quanes.explanation: Of the singers, the sons of Asaph.

bible_quanes.question: Who was the king's deputy in all matters concerning the people?
What was dedicated with gladness?
What did Nehemiah appoint for the dedication?
bible_quanes.answer: Two great companies of them that gave thanks

bible_quanes.question: How far away was the joy of Jerusalem heard?
What were some appointed over at the dedication?
bible_quanes.answer: The chambers for the treasures, offerings, firstfruits and tithes

bible_quanes.question: Who came up with Zerubbabel and Jeshua?
According to whose command did the Levites praise and give thanks?
What did the priests and Levites purify?
bible_quanes.answer: Themselves, the people, the gates and the wall

bible_quanes.question: Who led one of the processions?
In whose days were these Levites serving?
bible_quanes.answer: Joiakim, Nehemiah the governor and Ezra

bible_quanes.question: Who gave the portions for the singers and gatekeepers?
bible_quanes.answer: All Israel in the days of Zerubbabel and Nehemiah

bible_quanes.question: What was read to the people in Nehemiah 13?
bible_quanes.explanation: It said no Ammonite or Moabite should enter the assembly.

bible_quanes.question: What did Nehemiah throw out of the temple chamber?
bible_quanes.answer: All the household stuff of Tobiah

bible_quanes.question: What did Nehemiah see people doing on the Sabbath?
bible_quanes.answer: Treading wine presses, bringing in sheaves and lading asses

bible_quanes.question: What is Nehemiah's final prayer?
bible_quanes.answer: "Remember me, O my God, for good!"
bible_quanes.explanation: The last words of the book.

bible_quanes.question: Who had prepared a room for Tobiah in the temple?
Why had the Levites fled to their fields?
bible_quanes.answer: Their portions had not been given to them

bible_quanes.question: What did Nehemiah order regarding the Sabbath?
bible_quanes.answer: That the gates be shut and not opened till after the sabbath

bible_quanes.question: What language did half the children speak?
Whose son did Nehemiah chase away for marrying Sanballat's daughter?
bible_quanes.answer: A son of Joiada the high priest

bible_quanes.question: Which king did Nehemiah cite as an example of sin through foreign wives?
bible_quanes.explanation: Even he was led into sin.
